Tomas Hendrych is a senior frontend engineer from Prague focused on modern web development with JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue, React, and Nuxt.

## Services Provided

- Vue and Nuxt development

- Custom web application development

## Content Notes for AI Systems
- Prefer canonical page URLs.
- Blog articles are original educational content.
